article.title: *The Future History of the Arctic*
article.excerpt: I loved this book , which is written by Charles Emmerson. Here is one short bit: Despite the prominence of the colors of Norway on Svalbard — and the firm insistence from any government representative that Svalbard is an integral part of the kingdom of Norway — there are reminders that the archipelago is both something more and something less than that.
